page.overview:
Who is Dwimveandra?

Each sorceress who graduated the school of magic can choose between three possible ways of the further career. She can stay in the academy as an assistant to preceptresses; ask one of the independent mistresses to take her into service as regular apprentice; or become a dwimveandra.

Dwimveandra is obliged to roam throughout the land, taking odd jobs from various masters, in various places, in order to return to the academy after a few years to apply for the examination and promotion to position of the mistress. Unlike the wandering journeymen from the non-magic guilds, dwimveandras do not have to worry about lack of food nor money - they are able to draw from the special scholarship fund funded by the Chapter.
